name: Brawl Stars API
tagline: Official Supercell API for Brawl Stars player, club, and battle data
description: Official Brawl Stars developer API from Supercell providing access to player profiles, club information, battle logs, rankings, and brawler data. Developers obtain a free API key by registering with an IP allowlist; requests authenticate via Bearer token. Useful for stats trackers, club tools, and community dashboards.

auth.details: Bearer token API key via Authorization header; free self-serve signup with IP allowlist at developer.brawlstars.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free developer keys; exact free request quotas not clearly published on official docs

use_cases: look up a Brawl Stars player profile by tag
fetch a player's recent battle log
get club members and club stats
query current event/map rotation or rankings
